_comment: P3 第七批金标：GET /api/v1/pricing-data（定价数据矩阵 / 历史）。old_sql = 旧路径实际执行的查询（同一份数据查两次：客户自建档位 + 成本表）；facade = 门面供数契约（一次 dataset、内核复用两份）；response = 旧路径真实响应。**生成期冻结了 datetime.now**（_pricing_reference 的 30 天窗口依赖 now）⇒ 两侧测试也必须冻结到同一时刻，否则 avg_30d 会漂。时间戳同时覆盖零/非零微秒。

old_sql.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, product_spec_json, spec_hash, amount, unit, effective_from, source, notes, created_at FROM customer_cost_items WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND left(spec_hash, length($2))=$2 AND status='active' AND customer_id=$3 ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, customer_id, product_spec_json, spec_hash, amount, unit, effective_from, source, notes, created_at FROM customer_cost_items WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND left(spec_hash, length($2))=$2 AND status='active' AND customer_id=$3 ORDER BY id DESC

customer_cost_items.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, product_spec_json, spec_hash, amount, unit, CASE WHEN to_char(effective_from AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(effective_from AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(effective_from AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS effective_from, source, notes, CASE WHEN to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS created_at FROM customer_cost_items WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND left(spec_hash, length($2))=$2 AND status='active' AND customer_id=$3 ORDER BY id DESC
